newsitem.title: USA: Calif. seeks public members for electricity board.
newsitem.headline: Calif. seeks public members for electricity board.

text.p: The California Energy Commission and the California Public Utilities Commission said Friday they were accepting applications for three public members to fill a five-member Electric Restructuring Oversight Board.
The board was created by recent state legislation that ends California's system of electric power monopolies.
Gov. Pete Wilson will appoint the three public members subject to State Senate confirmation, while the Senate and Assembly will each appoint a non-voting member of the panel.
The board will oversee governing boards of an independent system operator and power exchange, and serve as appellate body for challenges to majority decisions of the independent system operator.
